name: comforter_brush
description: Comforter Brush is the "brushy" companion of Comforter, a bouncy, upright brush style script a contemporary, and non- traditional script font. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/comforter-brush .
